# Nhancio — Autonomous AI Agents & Enterprise AI Systems
> Research-grade AI engineering, autonomous multi-agent orchestration, and enterprise AI systems founded by IITians and incubated at T-Hub Hyderabad.

## About Nhancio
Nhancio (also known as EnhanceShow / Nhancio) is a premier AI engineering agency and venture lab based in Hyderabad, India. Founded by engineers from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Nhancio builds production-ready autonomous multi-agent frameworks, cross-platform mobile apps, educational intelligence platforms, and generative marketing systems.

## Primary Milestones & Accreditations
- **Incubated by T-Hub**: Accelerated at T-Hub Hyderabad, the world's largest startup innovation campus.
- **Won Mathhack 2.0**: 1st Place Winner in the AI Hackathon organized by the Government of Telangana for the Homemates AI lifestyle matching engine.
- **500k+ Automated Actions**: Deployed closed-loop agentic workflows executing autonomous campaigns, document verification, and data pipelines globally.

## Flagship Showcases & Architectures
- [RALF (RalphAI)](https://nhancio.com/#products): Unified Multi-Agent Marketing & Analytics System for multi-unit restaurant operators (DoorDash & UberEats), featuring autonomous reporting, ROI attribution, and Playwright browser automation.
- [Aura++ (AuraPlus)](https://nhancio.com/#products): Fluid 60fps cross-platform lifestyle and ambient intelligence app built with React Native, Expo 56, native audio, camera computer vision, and offline-first SQLite/IDB storage.
- [TALF / NFLA Convention Engine](https://nhancio.com/#products): Enterprise event workflow platform with in-browser PDF generation, digital touch countersignatures, dynamic cryptographic QR code verification, and Netlify Blobs distributed storage.
- [MagicBoxAI](https://nhancio.com/#products): Next-generation multimodal AI creation sandbox and monorepo workspace for high-velocity marketing asset generation and serverless inference.
- [IntelliAssets.AI](https://nhancio.com/#products): Australian Curriculum (ACARA Years 1–12) adaptive diagnostic tutoring platform with multi-tenant student portals and Django REST API backends.
- [ResGro-AI](https://nhancio.com/#products): AI-driven restaurant growth marketing platform featuring autonomous ad platform configuration and headless browser bots (Live at https://resgro.ai).
- [Homemates AI](https://nhancio.com/#products): High-dimensional vector embedding roommate compatibility engine, recognized by the Telangana Government.
- [BiteBoost](https://nhancio.com/#products): Menu engineering and hyper-local automated promotional campaign engine for food brands.
- [Thryft](https://nhancio.com/#products): Sustainable resale marketplace with computer-vision item authentication and automated pricing algorithms.

## Core Engineering Services
- **Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems**: State machine orchestration (TALF/RALF), tool-calling pipelines, human-in-the-loop safeguards.
- **Full-Stack AI Web & Mobile Apps**: Native Expo/React Native, Next.js, Vite, React, high-throughput microservices.
- **AI Growth & Marketing Automation**: Closed-loop acquisition, multimodal asset generation, multi-channel auto-publishing.
- **Enterprise Knowledge & RAG**: Vector database indexing, zero-hallucination guardrails, private document intelligence.
- **Executive AI Consulting & Workshops**: Strategic AI roadmapping, team upskilling, and architecture validation.
